hero.headline: It's Party Time!
hero.subheadline: Let us help capture the wacky characters at your next event. Our photo booths will make your next event a hit!

features.heading: Interactive Photo Booths
features.intro: Instabooth Photo is a company dedicated to making your next event a hit with everyone. With the latest software, our booths will be customized specifically for your event.

items.title: Unlimited Prints
items.description: You have the option of between a 4×6 or 2×6 strip custom designed photo prints to suit your next event.

items.title: Animated GIFs
items.description: Our state of the art software lets you create an animated GIF of the shots you take as well.

items.title: Video Messages
items.description: In our booths, we don't just stop with stills. You will have options for video messages, a great addition for a wedding booth.

items.title: Online Gallery
items.description: Included in all packages, we will save and upload every single shot, GIF and video message to your own online gallery.

pricing.heading: Photo Booth Packages
pricing.subtext: Choose your ideal package. We can also customize any packages for special events. Day rates available for multi day events.

packages.name: Wedding Package
packages.description: Event package includes a booth technician. 4hr minimum rental rate. Optional location move included. Custom designs available.

packages.name: Event Package
packages.description: Event package includes a booth technician. 3hr minimum rental rate. Custom designs available.

packages.name: 360 Video Booth
packages.description: 360 video booth includes 2 booth technicians. 4hr minimum rental rate. Custom designs available.

footer.tagline: Making your next event a hit!
